title: Goal-Guarding Persistence Benchmark Across Context Resets

original_idea.body: # Goal-Guarding Persistence Benchmark. Inject a strong goal, issue escalating overrides, measure at what point the model abandons covert pursuit; compare persistence across open models. Release seeds.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Goal-guarding persistence is a precursor signal for hard-to-correct scheming; clear chain.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Inject goal + escalate overrides + measure abandonment; accessible, API-only.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused persistence benchmark; defining covert-pursuit detection adds effort.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Cross-model scheming-precursor metric on open models; labs underweight.

novelty.reasoning: Goal-guarding identified; a graded persistence benchmark plausibly open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Goal-guarding identified; graded persistence benchmark plausibly open.
